Spray Foam Insulation Removal

We remove spray foam insulation from lofts and roofs, clean the timbers and give you the photos and paperwork your surveyor and mortgage lender ask for. We're roofers as well as removal specialists, so we understand the roof the foam is stuck to.

"We don't just remove spray foam, we understand the roof it's attached to." Dean, founder

Roofers and Removal Specialists in One Team

Some roofers take spray foam out without fully cleaning the rafters, and without the specialist documents lenders and surveyors need. Some removal companies don't know enough about roofs to spot damaged felt, roof defects or ventilation problems, and that can leave you with more trouble later, including internal felt repairs that don't work.

Our directly employed teams cover all of it: spray foam removal, timber cleaning, roof repairs, full roof replacements and loft insulation. So if we find a problem with the roof once the foam is off, the same team can put it right.

What You Get on Every Removal

We use quality materials, photograph the work throughout, take moisture readings where they are needed and hand over full documentation for you, your surveyor and your mortgage lender. Insurance-backed guarantees are available on eligible work, subject to the terms of the guarantee.

What Others Get Wrong

The biggest problem we come across is a lack of care and attention to detail. Some companies rush the removal and leave spray foam residue on the roof timbers, especially in the hard-to-reach parts. We've also seen residue covered over with new loft insulation instead of being taken off. We clean the timbers completely and photograph every stage.

A Recent Job

Acorn Drive, Belper, 2025: the roof tiles and the closed-cell spray foam all removed and the roof timbers cleaned, then new membrane, treated battens and a complete new tiled roof. Signed off by Building Control and passed by HSBC.

When People Call Us

  • Your mortgage lender has raised concerns about spray foam in the loft
  • A surveyor's report recommends it comes out
  • You're struggling to sell or remortgage because of it

How Long It Takes

Usually 2 to 5 working days, depending on the size of the property and the type of spray foam. Every job is surveyed and quoted individually.

What the Government Says

The government published guidance on spray foam, mortgages and removal on 22 October 2026. It says to get advice from a specialist surveyor before deciding, and that removal won't always mean a lender will lend. Read our summary of the guidance.
